protocol.fit: Only C71 fit onset windows/eligible observed labels/all6step eligibility. Empirical node positive rates from eligible rows,missing labels ignored;no fitted-classifier in-sample residuals.
protocol.scenario_bank: 2fixedMonteCarlo seeds20261013/20261029,2048draws each. Bootstrap same fit windows/masks;independent uniforms and randomized binary-tie empirical dependence use same base jitters. Missing label->independent uniform. No tuned shrinkage/rho/distance hyperparameter.
protocol.scope: Only onset last step changes,ongoing copied. Rank calibrated p and search all prefixes k0..N. General joint global optimality not claimed. Six-step evidence from hypothetical fit masks;no actualfuture mask API.
protocol.decision: C71 decision arrays,old references/control probabilities verified by C75. Choose best ORDER,incumbent first. Fit bank sealed before decision;MonteCarlo member policies are diagnostics only.
protocol.selection: Later15days same3eventseeds,origin deduplicated gain>=.01 and7dayblock95CI lower>0;otherwise incumbent. Seal before assessment.
protocol.assessment: Previously viewed public observation proxy calendars,not latent/private/final. Fit mask law unconditional on current history and observation/latent mismatch are unverified assumptions.
protocol.reuse: C72b2196raw input rebuilds and C75probability/calibration proof explicitly reused;no new raw windows or probability calibrator/classifier fit in this study.
protocol.algorithm_reference: https://arxiv.org/abs/1302.7149;own binary scenario adaptation,no external code copied
